path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "7B", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: including a charge for that offence in a fresh indictment within the meaning of section 164; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "7B", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: amending an indictment under section 165 so that it includes a charge for that offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "7B", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of a proceeding that relates (wholly or partly) to an offence that is charged in accordance with subsection (2), the offence charged is taken to have been in force when the conduct allegedly occurred.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "7B", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In any such proceeding, any requirement to prove that the complainant was of a particular age is satisfied if the prosecution proves that the complainant was of that age at some time during the period.

heading: Order for amendment of charge-sheet
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court at any time may order that a charge-sheet be amended in any manner that the court thinks necessary, unless the required amendment cannot be made without injustice to the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a charge-sheet is amended by order under this section, the charge-sheet is to be treated as having been filed in the amended form for the purposes of the hearing and all proceedings connected with the hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An amendment of a charge-sheet that has the effect of charging a new offence cannot be made after the expiry of the period, if any, within which a proceeding for the offence may be commenced.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a limitation period applies to the offence charged in the charge-sheet, the charge-sheet may be amended after the expiry of the limitation period if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the charge-sheet before the amendment sufficiently disclosed the nature of the offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the amendment does not amount to the commencement of a proceeding for a new offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the amendment will not cause injustice to the accused.

heading: Errors etc. in charge-sheet
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "9", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "9", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A charge-sheet is not invalid by reason only of a failure to comply with Schedule 1.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "9", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A charge on a charge-sheet is not invalid by reason only of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "9", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: omitting to state the time at which the offence was committed unless time is an essential element of the offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "9", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: incorrectly stating the time at which the offence was committed; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "9", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: stating the offence to have been committed on an impossible day or on a day that never happened.

heading: Listing of matter for mention hearing or filing hearing in the Magistrates' Court
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a charge-sheet contains a charge for a summary offence, the proceeding must be listed for a mention hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (3), if a charge-sheet contains a charge for an indictable offence that may be heard and determined summarily, the proceeding may be listed for a mention hearing or a filing hearing, having regard to any request for a committal proceeding included on the charge-sheet.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a notice to appear is served under section 21 and a charge-sheet is filed in accordance with section 22, the proceeding must be listed for a mention hearing on the date specified in the notice to appear.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite subsections (1) and (2), if a charge-sheet contains a charge for an indictable offence that is not an indictable offence that may be heard and determined summarily, the proceeding must be listed for a filing hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A mention hearing is the first hearing for a charge that will be heard and determined summarily.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A filing hearing is the first stage in a committal proceeding under Chapter 4.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 28(1) sets out the indictable offences that may be heard and determined summarily.

heading: Place of hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "11", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "11", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A criminal proceeding in the Magistrates' Court is to be heard at the venue of the court that is nearest to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "11", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the place where the offence is alleged to have been committed; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "11", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the place of residence of the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "11", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: except where otherwise provided by this or any other Act or by a nomination under subsection (2).

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 11(1) amended by No. 33/2018 ss 38, 46.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "11", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 50, "rect": {"page": 50, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 524.9, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 573.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "11", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Part 2 of the Magistrates' Court Act 1989 sets out the special requirements for matters that may be heard in the various Divisions of the Magistrates' Court: the Drug Court Division, the Koori Court Division, the Specialist Family Violence Court Division and the Neighbourhood Justice Division.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "11", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Chief Magistrate may from time to time, by notice published in the Government Gazette, nominate a venue of the Magistrates' Court as a venue for the hearing of a specified criminal proceeding or a specified class of criminal proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "11", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A criminal proceeding in the Magistrates' Court is not invalid only because it was conducted at a venue of the court other than the venue referred to in subsection (1) or nominated under subsection (2).

heading: Court may issue summons or warrant to arrest
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On the filing of a charge-sheet under section 6, an application may be made to a registrar of the Magistrates' Court for the issue of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a summons to answer to the charge directed to the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a warrant to arrest in order to compel the attendance of the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: unless a notice to appear has been served on the accused under Division 2.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 12(1) inserted by No. 1/2016 s. 22(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "12", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 52, "rect": {"page": 52, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 396.5, "x1": 118.8, "y1": 444.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: There is a presumption in favour of proceeding by summons if an accused is a child—see section 345 of the Children, Youth and Families Act 2005.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application under subsection (1)(b) must be made by the informant personally but an application under subsection (1)(a) may be made by the informant or a person on behalf of the informant.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 12(3) amended by No. 20/2025 s. 6.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "12", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 52, "rect": {"page": 52, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 529.5, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 568.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application under subsection (1) may be made by the applicant in person, by post, by electronic communication or otherwise in accordance with the manner prescribed by the rules of court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an application under subsection (1), the registrar must, if satisfied that the charge discloses an offence known to law, issue—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a summons to answer to the charge; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: subject to subsection (5), a warrant to arrest.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 12(5) amended by No. 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 38.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "12", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 53, "rect": {"page": 53, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A registrar of the Magistrates' Court must not issue in the first instance a warrant to arrest unless satisfied by sworn or affirmed evidence, whether oral or by affidavit, that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it is probable that the accused will not answer a summons; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused has absconded, is likely to abscond or is avoiding service of a summons that has been issued; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a warrant is required or authorised by any other Act or for other good cause.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused fails to appear in answer to a summons, sections 80 and 81 provide for the issue of a warrant to arrest the accused.  Section 330 provides for the issue of a warrant to arrest a person who has been remanded in custody or granted bail to attend a hearing but fails to attend. Section 29 of the Magistrates' Court Act 1989 enables a

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "14", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: There is a presumption in favour of proceeding by summons if an accused is a child—see section 345 of the Children, Youth and Families Act 2005.

text: If a police officer or a public official issues a summons under subsection (1), he or she must file the charge-sheet and summons in the Magistrates' Court within 7 days after signing the charge-sheet.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "14", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If it appears to the Magistrates' Court that subsection (2) has not been complied with in relation to a proceeding, the court may strike out the charge.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 14(3) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(d).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "14", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 55, "rect": {"page": 55, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 357.7, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 406.1}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: Section 401(3) allows the court to award costs if a charge is struck out.

heading: Contents of summons
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "15", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "15", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A summons to answer to a charge must direct the accused to appear at the venue of the Magistrates' Court referred to in section 11 on a specified date and at a specified time to answer the charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "15", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A summons to answer to a charge for an indictable offence that is to be served on a corporate accused must state that, if the accused does not appear in answer to the summons, the Magistrates' Court may proceed—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "15", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of an indictable offence that may be heard and determined summarily, to hear and determine the charge in the absence of the accused in accordance with Division 10 of Part 3.3; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "15", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in any case, to conduct a committal proceeding in the absence of the accused in accordance with Chapter 4.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "15", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See sections 80, 81 and 82 for consequences of failing to appear in answer to a summons.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "15", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 28(1) sets out the indictable offences that may be heard and determined summarily.

heading: Personal service of summons
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 16 amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(e).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "16", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 56, "rect": {"page": 56, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 233.1, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 272.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "16", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Except where otherwise expressly enacted, every summons to answer to a charge must be served personally on the accused in accordance with section 391—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "16", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: in the case of a charge for an indictable offence in respect of which a registrar of the Magistrates' Court has fixed a date for a filing hearing, at least 7 days before that date or any other time before that date that is prescribed by the rules of court.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 16 amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(f).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "16", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 56, "rect": {"page": 56, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 436.5, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 475.6}, "confidence": "high"}]

heading: Summons for summary offence may be served by ordinary service
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 17(1) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 51(g), 55/2014 s. 113(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 56, "rect": {"page": 56, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 516.5, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 574.1}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: A summons to answer to a charge for a summary offence (other than a traffic camera offence) must be served personally on the accused in accordance with section 391 unless the informant is satisfied that ordinary service is appropriate in all the circumstances.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 17(1) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(h).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 56, "rect": {"page": 56, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 605.3, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 653.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 394 provides for ordinary service.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the nature and gravity of the alleged offence;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the accused has previously been found guilty or convicted of any similar offence;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the period of time that has elapsed since the accused's address for service was ascertained.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 17(3) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 51(i), 55/2014 s. 113(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 57, "rect": {"page": 57, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 347.2, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 404.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a summons is served in accordance with section 394(1)(a), evidence of service must state—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: how the informant ascertained the address to which the summons was posted; and

text: the time and place of posting; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the informant considered the matters referred to in subsection (2) before determining to effect service by post.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 17A inserted by No. 55/2014 s. 114.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 57, "rect": {"page": 57, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 495.4, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 534.5}, "confidence": "high"}]

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Informant must nominate address etc. for service of documents
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "18", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "18", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An informant must nominate in writing a business address, email address, if any, and fax number for service on the informant of documents in relation to a charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "18", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A nomination under subsection (1) may be included on a charge-sheet or any other document served with a charge-sheet.

heading: Extension of return date if summons not served
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the informant has not served a summons to answer to a charge, the appropriate registrar may extend a return date specified in the summons without cause on one occasion on the application of the informant—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: before the return date; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: within 28 days after the return date.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 19(2) amended by No. 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 38.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "19", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 58, "rect": {"page": 58, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 521.2, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 569.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The appropriate registrar may extend a return date on a subsequent occasion on the application of the informant—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: before the current return date; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: within 28 days after the current return date—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the registrar is satisfied by sworn or affirmed evidence, whether oral or by affidavit, that reasonable efforts have been made to serve the summons.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See also section 331 as to the court's general power of adjournment.

heading: Adjournment of proceeding on application of accused
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "20", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On the application of the accused, the appropriate registrar may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "20", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: See also section 331 as to the court's general power of adjournment.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 21(1) amended by No. 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 41.3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "21", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 59, "rect": {"page": 59, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 455.3, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 503.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
