text: if the notice is served by a public official, state the name of the employer of the public official; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "21", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: state a telephone number and email address at which the person serving the notice may be contacted and the business address of the person and may state similar details for a person authorised to act in relation to the notice on behalf of the person serving the notice; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "21", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: state the full name and address of the person served with the notice; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "21", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: state the offence that the person served with the notice is suspected of having committed; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "21", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: state in general terms the circumstances of the suspected offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "21", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "g", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: direct the person served with the notice to appear at a venue of the Magistrates' Court on a date (at least 28 days after the date of service of the notice) and at a time specified in the notice to answer any charge in respect of the suspected offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "21", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "h", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: include a summary of this Division; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "21", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "i", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: be signed by the person serving the notice.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "21", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A notice to appear must be served by—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "21", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: giving it to the person to be served; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "21", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the person does not accept it, by putting it down in the person's presence and telling the person the nature of the document.

heading: Notice to appear lapses unless charge-sheet filed within 14 days
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "22", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 22(1) amended by Nos 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 41.4), 20/2025 s. 8.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "22", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 60, "rect": {"page": 60, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 623.8, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 681.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "22", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a police officer or a public official serves a notice to appear on a person, the notice lapses on the expiry of 14 days after service unless, within that period, the police officer or public official files in the Magistrates' Court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "22", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a charge-sheet containing a charge against the person for the suspected offence stated in the notice to appear or a related offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "22", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a copy of the notice to appear; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "22", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: evidence of service.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "22", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Failure to file a charge-sheet in accordance with subsection (1) does not affect the filing of a charge-sheet at any later time.

heading: Notice to be given on lapsing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "23", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 23(1) amended by No. 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 41.5).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "23", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 61, "rect": {"page": 61, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 311.8, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 360.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "23", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Within 7 days after the lapsing of a notice to appear, the police officer or public official who served the notice must ensure that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "23", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: written notice is given to the person on whom the notice to appear was served that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "23", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a charge-sheet has not been filed; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "23", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person is not required to appear at the Magistrates' Court on the date and at the time specified in the notice to appear; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "23", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court is notified that the notice to appear has lapsed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "23", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A notice under subsection (1) is given by sending it by prepaid ordinary post addressed to the person at the last known address of the person.

heading: Preliminary brief to be served if charge-sheet filed
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a charge-sheet is filed in accordance with section 22(1), the informant must—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 24(a) amended by No. 48/2012 s. 11.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "24", "sub_path": ["(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 61, "rect": {"page": 61, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 608.2, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 647.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: serve a preliminary brief on the accused within 21 days after the day on which the charge-sheet is filed; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: on the return date have available a copy of the preliminary brief for provision to the accused or the legal practitioner representing the accused, on request.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 36 sets out how a preliminary brief must be served.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 37 sets out the contents of a preliminary brief, including a copy of the charge-sheet.

heading: Non-appearance of accused served with notice to appear
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "25", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "25", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a charge-sheet containing a charge for a summary offence is filed against an accused in accordance with section 22(1) and the accused does not appear in answer to the notice to appear, the Magistrates' Court may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "25", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: issue a warrant to arrest the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "25", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: proceed to hear and determine the charge in the absence of the accused in accordance with Division 10 of Part 3.3; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "25", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: adjourn the proceeding on any terms that it considers appropriate.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "25", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a charge-sheet containing a charge for an indictable offence that may be heard and determined summarily is filed against an accused in accordance with section 22(1) and the accused does not appear in answer to the notice to appear, the Magistrates' Court may  issue a warrant to arrest the accused.

heading: Notice to appear does not commence proceeding
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "26", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Service of a notice to appear does not commence a criminal proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "26", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Chapter 8 contains general provisions that apply to all criminal proceedings.

heading: Summary procedure
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: When a summary hearing may be held
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Summary offences
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "27", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A charge for a summary offence is to be heard and determined summarily in accordance with this Chapter or, if the case requires, Division 1 of Part 5.8.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 27 amended by No. 47/2014 s. 257.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "27", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 63, "rect": {"page": 63, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 311.8, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 350.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "27", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The procedure set out in the Fines Reform Act 2014 may be used instead of commencing a proceeding for certain offences. See section 99 of the Magistrates' Court Act 1989.

heading: Indictable offences that may be heard and determined summarily
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "28", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "28", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A charge for any of the following indictable offences may be heard and determined summarily by the Magistrates' Court, if section 29 is satisfied—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "28", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an offence referred to in Schedule 2;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "28", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an indictable offence under an Act or subordinate instrument or an offence at common law if the offence is described by an Act or subordinate instrument as being—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "28", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a level 5 offence or level 6 offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "28", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: punishable by level 5 or level 6 imprisonment or fine or both; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "28", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: punishable by a term of imprisonment not exceeding 10 years or a fine not exceeding 1200 penalty units or both— unless the contrary intention appears in this or any other Act or in any subordinate instrument.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "28", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A level 5 offence is punishable by 10 years imprisonment maximum and a level 6 offence is punishable by 5 years imprisonment maximum: section 109 of the Sentencing Act 1991.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "28", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an indictable offence is described as being punishable in more than one way or in one of 2 or more ways, all of those ways must be referred to in subsection (1) for subsection (1) to apply.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "28", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an indictable offence referred to in Schedule 2 is qualified by reference to a specified amount or value or a specified kind of property, that qualification is not affected by subsection (1)(b) or (2).

heading: When an indictable offence may be heard and determined summarily
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court may hear and determine summarily a charge for an offence to which section 28(1) applies if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court considers that the charge is appropriate to be determined summarily, having regard to the matters in subsection (2); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused consents to a summary hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 82 provides for a summary hearing without consent in the case of a corporate accused which fails to appear in answer to a summons.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 168(3) provides that a charge transferred by order under that section must be heard and determined summarily.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (1)(a), the Magistrates' Court must have regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the seriousness of the offence including—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the nature of the offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the manner in which the offence is alleged to have been committed, the apparent degree of organisation and the presence of aggravating circumstances; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the offence forms part of a series of offences being alleged against the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "iv", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the complexity of the proceeding for determining the charge; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 29(2)(b) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 6.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "29", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 65, "rect": {"page": 65, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 516.5, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 555.6}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-16T10:49:44.979080+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the adequacy of sentences available to the court, having regard to the criminal record of the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether a co-accused is charged with the same offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other matter that the court considers relevant.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A legal practitioner appearing for an accused may, on behalf of the accused, consent to a summary hearing of a charge for an indictable offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in subsection (2) applies to a proceeding in the Children's Court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a body corporate and a natural person are jointly charged with an indictable offence which may be heard and determined summarily, the Magistrates' Court must not hear and determine the charge summarily against either of the accused unless—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: each of them consents to a summary hearing; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "29", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the body corporate fails to appear in the proceeding, the natural person consents to a summary hearing and the court proceeds under section 82 to hear and determine the charge in the absence of the body corporate.

heading: Procedure for indictable offences that may be heard and determined summarily
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The informant or the accused may apply for a summary hearing under section 29(1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without any application under subsection (1), the Magistrates' Court may offer a summary hearing under section 29(1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application for, or an offer of, a summary hearing may be made at any time before the Magistrates' Court determines whether to commit the accused for trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 6(4) provides that an informant may include a request for a committal proceeding in a charge-sheet containing a charge for an indictable offence that may be heard and determined summarily.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an application for a summary hearing is made before the hearing of any evidence, the Magistrates' Court may seek from the prosecutor or, if the informant is appearing in person, the informant and he or she must give—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an outline of the evidence which will be presented for the prosecution; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other information which the court considers relevant—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: for the purpose of enabling the court to determine whether to grant a summary hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Any statement made by the prosecutor or informant under subsection (4) is not admissible in evidence in any subsequent proceeding in respect of the charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court grants a summary hearing, the hearing and determination of the charge must be conducted in accordance with Part 3.3.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sections 112A to 113D of the Sentencing Act 1991 provide for maximum penalties in the Magistrates' Court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (8), if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a committal hearing commences; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court subsequently grants a summary hearing—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court may, with the consent of the accused, admit as evidence in the summary hearing—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the oral evidence of any witness; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the statement of any witness; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any document or exhibit—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: given or tendered during the committal hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If evidence is admitted under subsection (7)—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court must, at the request of the informant or the accused, call or recall (as the case requires) any witness for examination or cross-examination; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the hearing must otherwise be conducted in the same manner as a proceeding for a summary offence.

heading: Procedure before summary hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: General
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Court may change place of hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "31", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court considers that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "31", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a fair hearing in a criminal proceeding cannot otherwise be had; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "31", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: for any other reason it is appropriate to do so—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "31", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court may order that the hearing be held at another place or venue of the court that the court considers appropriate.

heading: Accused entitled to copy of charge-sheet and particulars
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "32", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "32", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An accused is entitled to receive free of charge a copy of the charge-sheet from the informant or the appropriate registrar.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "32", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An accused is entitled to receive from the informant reasonable particulars of the charge.

heading: Unrepresented accused who requires legal advice
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "33", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "33", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an accused is charged with an offence punishable by imprisonment; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "33", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused is unrepresented on the return date—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "33", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "33", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: ask the accused whether the accused has sought legal advice; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "33", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if satisfied that the accused has not had a reasonable opportunity to obtain legal advice, grant an adjournment if so requested by the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "33", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: inform the accused that the accused has the right, if eligible, to legal aid under the Legal Aid Act 1978.

heading: Return of property
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "34", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "34", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "34", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: property has been taken from an accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "34", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court considers that the property or part of it can be returned consistently with the interests of justice and with the safe custody of the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "34", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court must direct that the property or part of it be returned to the accused or to any other person that the accused directs.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "34", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If property has been taken from a person other than the accused, the Magistrates' Court, on application by the person, may direct that the property be returned to the person at any time, and subject to any condition, that the court considers appropriate.

heading: Pre-hearing disclosure of prosecution case
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: When preliminary brief is to be served
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "35", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "35", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If required to do so by section 24, the informant must serve a preliminary brief on the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "35", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At any time after the commencement of a proceeding, the accused, by written notice to the informant, may request that a preliminary brief be served.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "35", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused gives notice under subsection (2), the informant must serve on the accused a preliminary brief within 14 days after receipt of the notice.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "35", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section prevents the informant from serving a preliminary brief on the accused at any other time.

heading: How preliminary brief must be served
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "36", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 36(1) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(j).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "36", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 71, "rect": {"page": 71, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 286.0, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 325.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "36", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A preliminary brief must be served personally on the accused in accordance with section 391 unless the informant is satisfied that ordinary service is appropriate in all the circumstances.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 36(1) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(k).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "36", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 71, "rect": {"page": 71, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 347.2, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 395.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "36", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 394 provides for ordinary service.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "36", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In considering whether to effect service of a preliminary brief by ordinary service, the informant must consider whether it is an appropriate method of service in all the circumstances as known by the informant including—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "36", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the nature and gravity of the alleged offence;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "36", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the accused has previously been found guilty or convicted of any similar offence;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "36", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the period of time that has elapsed since the accused's address for service was ascertained;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "36", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the manner of service of the summons to answer to the charge.

heading: Contents of preliminary brief
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A preliminary brief must include—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a copy of the charge-sheet in respect of the alleged offence; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 37(1)(ab) inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 814.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "37", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(ab)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 72, "rect": {"page": 72, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 230.8, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 269.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "ab", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if applicable, a copy of the record of reasons; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a notice in the form prescribed by the rules of court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: explaining this section and section 84; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: explaining the importance of the accused obtaining legal representation; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: advising that the accused has the right, if eligible, to legal aid under the Legal Aid Act 1978; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iv", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: providing details of how to contact Victoria Legal Aid; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a statement made by the informant personally that complies with subsection (2) and section 38; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any evidentiary certificate issued under any Act that is likely to be relevant to the alleged offence and is available at the time the preliminary brief is served; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 37(1)(e) amended by No. 81/2011 s. 4.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "37", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(e)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 72, "rect": {"page": 72, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 588.4, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 627.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a copy of the criminal record of the accused that is available at the time the preliminary brief is served or a statement that the accused has no previous convictions or infringement convictions known at that time; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the informant refuses to disclose any information, document or thing that is required to be included in the preliminary brief, a written notice that the informant refuses disclosure under section 45, identifying the ground for refusing disclosure; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "g", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a list of any other orders that are or will be sought, as known at the time of preparation of the preliminary brief.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 37(2) amended by No. 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 38.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "37", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 73, "rect": {"page": 73, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 307.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 355.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A statement by the informant in a preliminary brief must be a complete and accurate statement of the material available to the prosecution at the time the statement is sworn or affirmed, signed or attested and must include—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a statement of the alleged facts on which the charge is based, including reference to the material available to the prosecution to support the alleged facts; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a description of the background to and consequences of the alleged offence, if known; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a summary of any statements made by the accused concerning the alleged offence, including any confession or admission; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a list of the names of all persons who, at the time the statement is signed, may be called by the prosecution as witnesses at the hearing of the charge, indicating whether those persons have made statements; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a list of any things the prosecution may tender as exhibits, indicating whether they are in the possession of the prosecution at the time the statement is signed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A preliminary brief may include any other information, document or thing that is relevant to the alleged offence and may assist the accused in understanding the evidence against the accused that is available to the prosecution.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Statements of key witnesses may be included in the preliminary brief.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court hears and determines a charge in the absence of the accused, section 84 provides that certain documents in a preliminary brief served on the accused at least 14 days before the hearing date are admissible in evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "37", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 86 as to proof of criminal record in the absence of the accused.

heading: Requirements for informant's statement in preliminary brief
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 38 amended by No. 68/2009 s. 9(a).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "38", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 74, "rect": {"page": 74, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 389.1, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 428.2}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 38(2) repealed by No. 68/2009 s. 9(b).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "38", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 74, "rect": {"page": 74, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 612.3, "x1": 120.6, "y1": 651.4}, "confidence": "low"}, {"raw": "Note to s. 38(2) repealed by No. 68/2009 s. 9(c).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "38", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 75, "rect": {"page": 75, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 509.0, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "low"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "38", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A statement by the informant in a preliminary brief must be—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "38", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "38", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: signed by the informant and contain an acknowledgment signed in the presence of a person referred to in Schedule 3 that the statement is true and correct and is made in the belief that a person making a false statement in the circumstances is liable to the penalties of perjury; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "38", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in a form, and attested to in a manner, prescribed by the rules of court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "38", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 38 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 9(d).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "38", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 75, "rect": {"page": 75, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 217.0, "x1": 511.1, "y1": 256.1}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: Section 414 provides for acknowledgment of false statements.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "39", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "40", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Expert evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 50(1) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(q).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "50", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 92, "rect": {"page": 92, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 215.5, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 254.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused intends to call a person as an expert witness at the hearing of the charge, the accused must serve on the informant in accordance with section 392 and file in court a copy of the statement of the expert witness in accordance with subsection (2)—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: at least 7 days before the day on which the contest mention hearing is to be held; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if there is no contest mention hearing, at least 7 days before the summary hearing; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the statement is not then in existence, as soon as possible after it comes into existence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The statement must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: contain the name and business address of the witness; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: describe the qualifications of the witness to give evidence as an expert; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: set out the substance of the evidence it is proposed to adduce from the witness as an expert, including the opinion of the witness and the acts, facts, matters and circumstances on which the opinion is formed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 177 of the Evidence Act 2008 provides for certificates of expert evidence.

heading: Alibi evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies to an accused on a summary hearing, if the accused is represented by a legal practitioner.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An accused must not, without leave of the court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: give evidence personally; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: adduce evidence from another witness—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in support of an alibi unless the accused has given notice of alibi within the period referred to in subsection (3).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A notice of alibi is given by serving the notice on the prosecutor or the informant—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: at least 7 days before the day on which the contest mention hearing is to be held; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if there is no contest mention hearing, at least 7 days before the summary hearing; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the notice is not then in existence, as soon as possible after it comes into existence.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 51(4) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(r).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "51", "sub_path": ["(4)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 93, "rect": {"page": 93, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 398.8, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 437.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A notice of alibi must be served in accordance with section 392.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A notice of alibi must contain—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: particulars as to time and place of the alibi; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the name and last known address of any witness to the alibi; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the name and address of a witness are not known, any information which might be of material assistance in finding the witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the name and address of a witness are not included in a notice of alibi, the accused must not call that person to give evidence in support of the alibi unless the court is satisfied that the accused took reasonable steps to ensure that the name and address would be ascertained.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused is notified by the informant that a witness named or referred to in a notice of alibi has not been traced, the accused must give written notice to the informant, without delay, of any further information which might be of material assistance in finding the witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court must not refuse leave under subsection (2) if it appears to the court that the accused was not informed of the requirements of this section.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "9", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "9", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an accused gives notice of alibi under this section; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "9", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the prosecutor requests an adjournment—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": "9", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court must grant an adjournment for a period that appears to the court to be necessary to enable investigation of the alibi unless it appears that to do so would prejudice the proper presentation of the case of the accused.

heading: Offence to communicate with alibi witness
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "52", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "52", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person (other than a person referred to in subsection (2)) has been named or referred to as a proposed witness in a notice of alibi given under section 51—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "52", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a person acting for the prosecution; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 52(1)(b) amended by No. 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 41.5).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "52", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 94, "rect": {"page": 94, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 556.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 604.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "52", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a police officer—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "52", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: must not communicate with that person directly or indirectly with respect to the charge or any related matter before the conclusion of the proceeding, including any rehearing, without the consent and presence during the communication of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "52", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the legal practitioner representing the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "52", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if not legally represented, the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "52", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Penalty: Level 8 imprisonment (1 year maximum)

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "52", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (1) does not apply to a person who the accused has been notified may be called as a witness for the prosecution at the summary hearing.

heading: Mention hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At a mention hearing, the Magistrates' Court may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the offence is an indictable offence that may be heard and determined summarily, grant a summary hearing;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: proceed immediately to hear and determine the charge;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: fix a date for a contest mention hearing;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: fix a date for a summary hearing of the charge;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: make any other order or give any direction that the court considers appropriate.

heading: Documents to be provided by police at first mention hearing
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 53A inserted by No. 81/2011 s. 6.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "53A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 95, "rect": {"page": 95, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 571.3, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 610.5}, "confidence": "high"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 53A(1) amended by No. 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 41.5).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "53A", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 95, "rect": {"page": 95, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 624.7, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 673.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "53A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies if the informant is a police officer.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "53A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At the first mention hearing, the informant must have the following documents available for provision to the accused or the legal practitioner representing the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "53A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: identifying any issues in dispute; and
