path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The presumption against criminal responsibility arises for an offence allegedly committed by a child when the person was 12 or 13 years of age.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 54(7)(c) inserted by No. 22/2020 s. 12.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "54", "sub_path": ["(7)", "(c)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 98, "rect": {"page": 98, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 325.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 364.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: identifying the steps required to advance the case; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 54(7)(d) inserted by No. 22/2020 s. 12.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "54", "sub_path": ["(7)", "(d)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 98, "rect": {"page": 98, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 379.0, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 418.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other purpose prescribed by the rules of court.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 54(2) amended by Nos 30/2010 s. 59(1), 48/2012 s. 12.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "54", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 97, "rect": {"page": 97, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 377.5, "x1": 514.2, "y1": 425.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a preliminary brief is served within 21 days after the day on which the charge-sheet is filed, a summary case conference must be conducted before—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the charge is set down for a contest mention hearing or a summary hearing; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a request for a full brief is made under section 39(1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court may direct the parties to attend a summary case conference.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section prevents a summary case conference from being conducted at any other time, if the parties agree.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 54(5) substituted by No. 30/2010 s. 59(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "54", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 97, "rect": {"page": 97, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 586.9, "x1": 517.8, "y1": 626.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused is not legally represented, the Magistrates' Court may dispense with the requirement under subsection (2) to conduct a summary case conference.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 54(6) substituted by No. 30/2010 s. 59(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "54", "sub_path": ["(6)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 97, "rect": {"page": 97, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 648.1, "x1": 517.8, "y1": 687.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A summary case conference must be conducted in accordance with the rules of court.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 54(7) amended by No. 22/2020 s. 12.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "54", "sub_path": ["(7)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 98, "rect": {"page": 98, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: anything said or done in the course of a summary case conference; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any document prepared solely for the purposes of a summary case conference—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is not admissible in any proceeding before any court or tribunal or in any inquiry in which evidence is or may be given before any court or person acting judicially, unless—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: all parties to the summary case conference agree to the giving of the evidence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the proceeding is a criminal proceeding for an offence alleged to have been committed during, or in connection with, the summary case conference.

heading: Contest mention hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies to a proceeding for—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a summary offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an indictable offence that may be heard and determined summarily.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court may, between the return date and the day on which the charge is heard, from time to time conduct a contest mention hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At a contest mention hearing, the Magistrates' Court may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: require the parties to provide an estimate of the time expected to be needed for the hearing of the charge;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: require the parties to advise as to the estimated number and the availability of witnesses (other than the accused) for the hearing of the charge and whether any witnesses are from interstate or overseas;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: request each party to indicate the evidence that party proposes to adduce and to identify the issues in dispute;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: require the accused to advise whether the accused is legally represented and has funding for continued legal representation up to and including the hearing of the charge;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: require the parties to advise whether there are any particular requirements of, or facilities needed for, witnesses and interpreters;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: order a party to make, file in court or serve (as the case requires) any written or oral material required by the court for the purposes of the proceeding;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "g", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: allow a party to amend a document that has been prepared by or on behalf of that party for the purposes of the proceeding;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "h", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the court considers that it is in the interests of justice to do so, dispense with or vary any requirement imposed on a party by or under this Part;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "i", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: require or request a party to do anything else for the case management of the proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused must attend all contest mention hearings.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note 1 to s. 55(4) amended by No. 38/2016 s. 9(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "55", "sub_path": ["(4)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": "1", "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 100, "rect": {"page": 100, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 175.1, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 223.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 3 defines attend.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 334 in relation to a corporate accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 330 gives the court power to excuse an accused from attending a hearing.

heading: Summary hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Joint or separate hearing of charges
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Multiple charges on single charge-sheet or multiple accused named on single charge-sheet
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "56", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "56", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a charge-sheet contains more than one charge, the charges must be heard together unless an order is made under section 58.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "56", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a charge-sheet names more than one accused, whether in the same charge or separate charges, the charge or charges against all accused must be heard together unless an order is made under section 58.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "56", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A separate charge-sheet must be filed against each accused.

heading: Joint hearing of charges on separate charge-sheets
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "57", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On the application of the prosecutor or the accused, the Magistrates' Court may order that any number of charges in separate charge-sheets be heard together.

heading: Order for separate hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a charge-sheet contains more than one charge, the Magistrates' Court may order that any one or more of the charges be heard separately.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a charge-sheet names more than one accused, the Magistrates' Court may order that charges against a specified accused be heard separately.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court may make an order under subsection (1) or (2) if the court considers that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the case of an accused may be prejudiced because the accused is charged with more than one offence in the same charge-sheet; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a hearing with co-accused would prejudice the fair hearing of the charge against the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: for any other reason it is appropriate to do so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court may make an order under subsection (1) or (2) before or during the hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court makes an order under subsection (1) or (2), the prosecutor may elect which charge is to be heard first.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The procedure on the separate hearing of a charge is the same in all respects as if the charge had been set out in a separate charge-sheet.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court makes an order for a separate hearing under subsection (1) or (2), the court may make any order for or in relation to the bail of the accused that the court considers appropriate.

heading: Diversion program
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Adjournment to undertake diversion program
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section does not apply to—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 59(1)(a) amended by No. 56/2013 s. 34(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "59", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 102, "rect": {"page": 102, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 509.7, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 548.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an offence punishable by a minimum or fixed sentence or penalty, including cancellation or suspension of a licence or permit to drive a motor vehicle and disqualification under the Road Safety Act 1986 or the Sentencing Act 1991 from obtaining such a licence or permit or from driving a motor vehicle on a road in Victoria but not including the incurring of demerit points under the Road Safety Act 1986 or regulations made under that Act; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an offence against section 49(1) of the Road Safety Act 1986 not referred to in paragraph (a).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If, at any time before taking a formal plea from an accused in a criminal proceeding for a summary offence or an indictable offence that may be heard and determined summarily—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused acknowledges to the Magistrates' Court responsibility for the offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it appears appropriate to the Magistrates' Court, which may inform itself in any way it considers appropriate, that the accused should participate in a diversion program; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: both the prosecution and the accused consent to the Magistrates' Court adjourning the proceeding for this purpose—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court may adjourn the proceeding for a period not exceeding 12 months to enable the accused to participate in and complete the diversion program.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An accused's acknowledgment to the Magistrates' Court of responsibility for an offence is inadmissible as evidence in a proceeding for that offence and does not constitute a plea.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused completes a diversion program to the satisfaction of the Magistrates' Court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: no plea to the charge is to be taken; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court must discharge the accused without any finding of guilt; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the fact of participation in the diversion program is not to be treated as a finding of guilt except for the purposes of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Division 1 of Part 3 and Part 10 of the Confiscation Act 1997; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: section 9 of the Control of Weapons Act 1990; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: section 151 of the Firearms Act 1996; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "iv", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Part 4 of the Sentencing Act 1991; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the fact of participation in the diversion program and the discharge of the accused is a defence to a later charge for the same offence or a similar offence arising out of the same circumstances.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused does not complete a diversion program to the satisfaction of the Magistrates' Court and the accused is subsequently found guilty of the charge, the Magistrates' Court must take into account the extent to which the accused complied with the diversion program when sentencing the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section affects the requirement to observe the rules of natural justice.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section does not affect the incurring of demerit points under the Road Safety Act 1986 or regulations made under that Act.

heading: Sentence indication
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Court may give sentence indication
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 60 amended by No. 49/2012 s. 4 (ILA s. 39B(1)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "60", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 104, "rect": {"page": 104, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 618.3, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 666.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At any time during a proceeding for a summary offence or an indictable offence that may be heard and determined summarily, the Magistrates' Court may indicate that, if the accused pleads guilty to the charge for the offence at that time, the court would be likely to impose on the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a sentence of imprisonment that commences immediately; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a sentence of a specified type.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 126 of the Magistrates' Court Act 1989 enables the court to close a proceeding to the public.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 60(2) inserted by No. 49/2012 s. 4.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "60", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 105, "rect": {"page": 105, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 291.0, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 330.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting its discretion under subsection (1), the Magistrates' Court may decide not to give a sentence indication under subsection (1) if the Magistrates' Court considers there is insufficient information before it of the impact of the offence on any victim of the offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Under section 5(2)(daa) of the Sentencing Act 1991, in sentencing an offender a court must have regard to the impact of the offence on any victim of the offence.

heading: Effect of sentence indication
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court gives a sentence indication under section 60; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused pleads guilty to the charge for the offence at the first available opportunity—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court, when sentencing the accused for the offence, must not impose a more severe type of sentence than the type of sentence indicated.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court gives a sentence indication under section 60; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused does not plead guilty to the charge for the offence at the first available opportunity—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court that hears and determines the charge must be constituted by a different magistrate, unless all the parties otherwise agree.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A sentence indication does not bind the Magistrates' Court on any hearing before the court constituted by a different magistrate.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A decision to give or not to give a sentence indication is final and conclusive.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application for a sentence indication and the determination of the application are not admissible in evidence against the accused in any proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section does not affect any right to appeal against sentence.

heading: Entering a plea
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Charge to be read or explained to accused before plea
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "62", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "62", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (2), the Magistrates' Court must ensure that any charge, as set out in the charge-sheet, is read to the accused or its substance is explained to the accused before the accused is asked to plead to the charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "62", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: It is not necessary that a charge be read, or its substance explained, to an accused who is represented by a legal practitioner if the Magistrates' Court considers it appropriate not to do so.

heading: Legal practitioner may enter plea on behalf of accused
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "63", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A legal practitioner appearing for an accused may, on behalf of the accused, enter a plea.

heading: Refusal to plead
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If, when an accused is asked to plead to a charge, the accused will not answer directly to the charge, the Magistrates' Court may order that a plea of not guilty be entered on behalf of the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A plea of not guilty entered under subsection (1) has the same effect as if the accused in fact had pleaded not guilty.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the Crimes (Mental Impairment and Unfitness to be Tried) Act 1997 when an accused is or may be unfit to stand trial.

heading: Pleading to course of conduct charge
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 64A inserted by No. 74/2014 s. 11.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "64A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 107, "rect": {"page": 107, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 399.6, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 438.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section course of conduct charge has the same meaning as in clause 4A of Schedule 1.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies if an accused, on being asked to plead to a course of conduct charge, informs the court that they—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: would plead guilty to the charge if it related only to a specified period falling within the period to which the charge set out in the charge-sheet relates; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: would plead not guilty to the charge insofar as it relates to any other period within the period to which the charge set out in the charge-sheet relates.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused informs the court in accordance with subsection (2) and the court is satisfied that, having regard to that information, it is not appropriate for the accused to be asked to plead to the charge, the court may adjourn the proceeding to allow a fresh charge-sheet to be filed relating only to the specified period referred to in subsection (2)(a).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a fresh charge-sheet as described in subsection

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is filed and the accused does not plead guilty to the charge as set out in that charge-sheet, a further fresh charge-sheet may be filed that sets out the original charge or an amended version of that charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "64A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused does not plead to that charge, the Magistrates' Court may order that a plea of not guilty be entered on behalf of the accused unless it considers that it is not in the interests of justice to do so.

heading: Opening addresses
history_json: [{"raw": "Pt 5.5 Div. 5 (Heading and ss 206A\u2013 206G) inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 823.", "kind": "amendment", "section": null, "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": "5", "part": "5.5", "def_name": null, "page": 234, "rect": {"page": 234, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 414.4, "x1": 126.3, "y1": 481.1}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "Ch. 8 Pt 8.2 Div. 5 (Heading) amended by No. 19/2017 s. 56.", "kind": "amendment", "section": null, "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "division": "5", "part": "8.2", "def_name": null, "page": 378, "rect": {"page": 378, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 211.0, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 268.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Parties may give opening addresses
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: With the leave of the Magistrates' Court and before any evidence is given—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the prosecutor may give an opening address to the court on the prosecution case against the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused may give an opening address to the court in response to the prosecutor's opening address.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court may limit the length of the opening addresses.

heading: Case for the accused
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Accused entitled to respond after close of prosecution case
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: After the close of the case for the prosecution, an accused is entitled—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to make a submission that there is no case for the accused to answer;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to answer the charge by choosing to give evidence or call other witnesses to give evidence or both;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: not to give evidence or call any witnesses.

heading: Election when accused is legally represented
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "67", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused is represented by a legal practitioner, at the close of the case for the prosecution, the Magistrates' Court may question the legal practitioner to determine which of the options referred to in section 66 the accused elects to take.

heading: Election when accused is not legally represented
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused is not represented by a legal practitioner, immediately after the close of the case for the prosecution the Magistrates' Court must inform the accused, in a manner that is likely to be understood by the accused that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused has the right to answer the charge and must choose either—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 68(1)(a)(i) amended by No. 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 38.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "68", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(a)", "(i)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 109, "rect": {"page": 109, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 461.8, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 510.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to give sworn or affirmed evidence, that is, to enter the witness box, take the oath or make an affirmation and say what the accused wants to say in answer to the charge and then to respond to any questions from the prosecution or the court about the evidence of the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to say nothing in answer to the charge; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 68(1)(b) amended by No. 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 38.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "68", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 109, "rect": {"page": 109, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 611.8, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 660.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in either case, the accused may call any witnesses to give sworn or affirmed evidence for the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: After giving the information referred to in subsection (1), the Magistrates' Court must ask the accused what the accused wants to do.

heading: Procedure for joint hearings if no-case submission made
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 69 (Heading) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 49(b).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "69", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 110, "rect": {"page": 110, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 205.0, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 253.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: After the close of the case for the prosecution, an accused who wishes to make a submission that there is no case for the accused to answer must do so at that time.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 69(2) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 49(c).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "69", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 110, "rect": {"page": 110, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 299.8, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 338.9}, "confidence": "high"}]

heading: Questioning to determine proper course of proceeding
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "70", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "70", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused intends to call witnesses to give evidence at the hearing, the accused must indicate, when called on by the Magistrates' Court to do so—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "70", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "70", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "70", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused must not present the case of the accused differently to the way indicated to the Magistrates' Court under subsection (1) without the leave of the court.

heading: Opening address of accused at beginning of case for the accused
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "71", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "71", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused intends to give evidence, or to call other witnesses on behalf of the accused, or both, the Magistrates' Court may grant leave to the accused to open the case for the accused if the court considers it appropriate to do so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "71", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "71", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court may limit the length of the opening address of the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "71", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "72", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A copy of the criminal record of the accused is included in the preliminary brief (section 37) or, if a preliminary brief is not served, in the full brief (section 41).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: finds the accused guilty in the absence of the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is satisfied that a copy of the criminal record of the accused was served on the accused at least 14 days before the hearing of the charge—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the criminal record is admissible only for the purpose of sentencing and—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 86(2)(c) amended by No. 81/2011 s. 11(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "86", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(c)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 121, "rect": {"page": 121, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 614.2, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 653.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is evidence that the accused has the previous convictions and infringement convictions set out in the criminal record; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is evidence of the particulars set out in the criminal record.

heading: Limitations on sentencing in absence of accused
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court proceeds to hear and determine a charge in the absence of the accused and finds the accused guilty, the court must not make a custodial order under Division 2 of Part 3 of the Sentencing Act 1991.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court finds an accused guilty in the absence of the accused on the basis of a preliminary brief—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 87(2)(a) amended by Nos 65/2011 s. 107(Sch. item 4.3), 26/2012 s. 74.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "87", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 122, "rect": {"page": 122, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 299.8, "x1": 125.7, "y1": 357.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court must not make an order under Part 3B of the Sentencing Act 1991 for a fine exceeding 20 penalty units and the total sum of orders for fines must not exceed in the aggregate 50 penalty units; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the total sum of orders made under Divisions 1 and 2 of Part 4 of the Sentencing Act 1991 for the payment of restitution or compensation must not exceed $2000.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 87(2) amended by No. 65/2011 s. 107(Sch. item 4.4).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "87", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 122, "rect": {"page": 122, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 449.8, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 507.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In addition to this section, the court cannot make an order that requires the consent of the accused to its making, for example, a community correction order.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If, at any time during the hearing, the Magistrates' Court considers that the charge, if proven, is likely to result in an order prohibited by subsection (1) or (2) or an order that requires the consent of the accused, the court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: must adjourn the proceeding to enable the accused to attend or to be brought before the court to answer to the charge; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may issue a warrant to arrest the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court finds a charge against a person proved and imposes a sentence in the absence of the person, the court must serve written notice on the person, at the address of the person on the register kept under section 18 of the Magistrates' Court Act 1989, of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the order of the court; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: their right to apply for a rehearing of the charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": "10", "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Part 3.4 provides for a rehearing in certain circumstances. In particular, section 94 provides for automatic rehearing in certain cases.
